docs.scope: MINIMAL AMENDMENT + RE-GATE PASS: docs/architecture/engine-seam.md already carries all 2026-07-02 session resolutions (SEAM-D10/D11/D12, SP-cgame amendment, C-unwind sweep) and has passed adversarial review plus two dry-run/patch cycles. decisions: SEAM-Q10 RESOLVED (record as SEAM-D13, session 2026-07-02): binding leaf crate. New crate crates/mp/engine-select (package mp_engine_select) holds the single cfg'd `pub type Engine` alias: the wasm arm is selected by cfg(target_arch = "wasm32"); Static by a Cargo feature `static` enabled only by static-transport builds; the default (non-wasm, no feature) is CEngine (NativeDll). It depends on abi-transport, where the concrete CEngine/Static backends live (SEAM-D9). Logic crates (mp_game/mp_cgame/mp_ui) dep on mp_engine_select and write `use mp_engine_select::Engine;` in `mod trap` — they contain zero cfg/features themselves, satisfying SEAM-D10 literally, and `mod trap` stays in each logic crate with the frozen non-generic wrappers. Shells select: jampgame/cgame/ui take the default; a static-linking engine build enables feature "static". Known cost (note it in the record): NativeDll and Static artifacts on the same host triple cannot share one feature-unified `cargo build --workspace` graph — those builds go per-package; wasm needs no feature (distinct target triple). SP needs NO select crate: sp game's `mod gi` binds the game_import_t table directly (SEAM-D2, always native) and sp cgame/ui are always Static — their aliases are fixed; state that in the record. workspace-architecture.md is ALREADY updated with the crate, its edges, and the selection paragraph — cite it, expect no contradiction.

docs.title: Module Loading

decisions: LOAD-D1 AMENDED (session 2026-07-02): the direct/bare LoadLibrary probe is WINDOWS-ONLY ground truth. Unix MP performs NO bare-dlopen probe — the CWD/installdir load in unix_main.c (~362-374) is #if 0-disabled ('bk010205 - do not load from installdir'); Unix order is FS_BuildOSPath(fs_basepath,...) -> FS_BuildOSPath(fs_cdpath,...) only (unix_main.c:373-402). ModuleSearchPolicy therefore sets direct_first per platform: Windows true (win_main.cpp:855), Unix false. Search-order goldens encode per-platform orders; slice 0's native-Linux policy is the faithful Unix order.

LOAD-Q4 RESOLVED (record as LOAD-D6, session 2026-07-02): the raw ABI fn-pointer aliases (RawSyscall, RawVmMain) MOVE to crates/native/platform (base tier — they are Raven-free platform-ABI vocabulary); abi-transport takes a downhill dep on native/platform and re-exports them, so existing abi-transport consumers are unaffected. No tier inversion; workspace-architecture.md gains the edge (updated separately). The frozen loader signatures now compile in native/platform with no new edges.

LOAD-Q2 RESOLVED (session 2026-07-02): Sys_UnpackDLL (win_main.cpp:762-800, called :849-852) is IN SCOPE — live retail pure-server behavior on the promised hosting path — but deferred to a later MP-server slice after the filesystem port (B2) lands the FS_ReadFile/FS_FileIsInPAK/FS_FOpenFileWrite calls it needs. Slice 0 explicitly stubs it (slice 0 is non-pure); record as a LOAD decision with the deferral rationale.

LOAD-Q3 RESOLVED (mechanical from oracle, record the frozen signature): ModuleRegistry::load_module follows Raven VM_Create's slot semantics (vm.cpp:471 region): reuse an existing slot by module name, else take the first free slot, Com_Error(ERR_FATAL) when all MAX_VM=3 slots are full. Freeze load_module(&mut self, ...) -> SlotId plus unload/restart against those semantics. ModuleRegistry's home crate is mp_engine_qcommon (mirrors vm.cpp's subsystem; per engine-seam session resolution) — give the exact crate::Type.field row the state-ownership section needs.

SEAM-Q8 RESOLVED upstream (cite engine-seam.md SEAM-D10, do not restate): crates/jampgame is the thin cdylib shell (deps abi_transport + mp_game) hosting ENGINE/exports/Dispatch — anchor the Slice 0 call-site references to it.
